question: does the 2026-10-07 self-distillation degeneracy survive replacing the ridge teacher with the fine-tuned PromoterAtlas encoder?
why_the_ridge_arm_is_here: positive control -- same substrate, splits, perturbations, students and thresholds; only the teacher differs. It must reproduce ~1.0000 or this harness proves nothing.

substrate.teacher_was_finetuned_on: GSE144621 peak tiles -- a DIFFERENT dataset
substrate.circularity: base model cleared_vs_GSE108535 per wiki/promoteratlas_circularity_2026-10-31.md; the contaminated trspred-urtecho2018 head is NOT used -- verified in code

outcomes_defined_before_running.HARNESS_BROKEN_RIDGE_CONTROL_DID_NOT_REP: the ridge teacher did NOT recover agreement >= the floor in this harness, so the harness fails to reproduce the 2026-10-07 result and no statement about any other teacher is licensed
outcomes_defined_before_running.TEACHER_NOT_COMPETENT_ON_THIS_SUBSTRATE: the fine-tuned teacher does not clear standalone-GC + CONTROL_MUST_DROP on GSE108535, so a student failing to copy it would be copying noise and the agreement is uninterpretable
outcomes_defined_before_running.DEGENERACY_PERSISTS_WITH_A_LEARNED_TEACH: the linear student reproduces the LEARNED teacher too (agreement >= floor and |d rho| <= tol), so the measured degeneracy is NOT specific to a linear oracle and the block stands
outcomes_defined_before_running.DEGENERACY_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER_TO_THE_LEAR: the ridge control reproduced as required while the learned teacher's linear student did NOT, so the identity that produced 1.0000 does not hold for this teacher
outcomes_defined_before_running.DISTILLATION_HELPS_ON_THE_LEARNED_TEACHE: some student BEATS the learned teacher on held-out measured expression by > beat margin

verdict_detail: ridge control reproduced at [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] while the learned teacher's linear student reached (rate, agreement, d_rho) = [(0.02, 0.7322, -0.0915), (0.05, 0.7399, -0.085), (0.1, 0.7506, -0.0835)] -- below the 0.99 floor
honest_limits: ONE element axis, ONE checkpoint (one of ten seeds), ONE substrate. This bounds the MECHANISM, not the eventual value of distillation.
CROSS-DATASET: the teacher was fine-tuned on GSE144621 tiles and is scored here on GSE108535, so its rho here is NOT the 0.6405 the arm reported and the two must never be quoted interchangeably.
A non-transfer verdict says the 1.0000 IDENTITY does not hold for this teacher. It does NOT show self-distillation WORKS -- that needs the real-data validation half the ban's own wording requires.
Perturbation is uniform random point substitution; a generator's candidates are not uniform, so this exercises the method's mechanics and not the real off-distribution gap.
The students use the one-hot basis. A student with a RICHER basis than tested here might copy the network more closely, so this is a lower bound on copyability.

prior_art_THIS_IS_THE_SECOND_ATTEMPT.why_that_matters: features/glm-self-distillation/ already held a feature record, an idea-anchor, a technical-plan and a 2026-10-31 brainstorm asking THIS EXACT question. A prior learned-teacher probe (scripts/glm_selfdistill_learned_teacher.py, bar wiki/glm_selfdistill_learned_teacher_acceptance_bar.json, result wiki/glm_selfdistill_learned_teacher_2026-10-31.json) RAN and its headline MECHANISM_DISSOLVES_WITH_LEARNED_TEACHER was WITHDRAWN by that review. I should have found it before designing anything; searching the vocabulary of what I was BUILDING instead of the arm being TOUCHED is the documented failure mode this repo already has a rail for.
prior_art_THIS_IS_THE_SECOND_ATTEMPT.what_was_withdrawn_there_and_why: C1: against the conv teacher a 1-feature GC student reproduced it BETTER than 600 positional features did, in 0 of 9 cells favouring the richer student. A strictly more expressive student copying strictly worse is the signature of a sample-limited fit, not of an irreducible teacher, so ~0.40 agreement could not support the dissolve claim.

C1_RE_APPLIED_TO_THIS_RUN.result: PASSES in 6 of 6 cells -- capacity ordering intact, unlike the withdrawn run
C1_RE_APPLIED_TO_THIS_RUN.contrast_with_the_withdrawn_conv_run: there linear 0.3843-0.4475 LOST to GC 0.4111-0.4567; here linear 0.7322-0.7506 beats GC 0.3279 by a wide margin and the MLP beats the linear student at low perturbation
C1_RE_APPLIED_TO_THIS_RUN.honest_timing: checked AFTER the run, prompted by finding that brainstorm, not before

its_other_defects_checked_against_this_r.M1_perturbed_set_correspondence: STRUCTURALLY AVOIDED, not merely passed: _perturb is called ONCE per rate and the single `pert` list feeds both teachers' labels AND both students' features, so the coincidence that run depended on cannot arise here
its_other_defects_checked_against_this_r.M2_mlp_convergence: DOES NOT APPLY -- measured 0 ConvergenceWarnings; agreement is stable (ridge 0.9994/0.9994/0.9991), not the 0.2375-0.9501 swing reported there
its_other_defects_checked_against_this_r.M3_perturbed_scale: SATISFIED -- copies=2, 16,346 perturbed rows against 8,173 train, which is that review's own recommendation 3

scope_limit_from_C2.what_this_run_does_NOT_establish: that the fine-tuned teacher carries irreducible structure no student could capture. The agreement arm is a one-hot linear student, which against a network is the POORER student, so the 0.99 floor is one it cannot reach a priori. Establishing irreducibility needs the capacity-matched student that review's recommendation 1 names, and that is NOT done here.
scope_limit_from_C2.what_it_DOES_establish_and_why_that_is_t: the ban's cited mechanism is a statement about SPAN, not about irreducibility: a ridge teacher's predictions lie IN the span of its own features, so a same-basis student recovers it by identity. student_linear is same-basis for the ridge teacher BY CONSTRUCTION, which is what makes the reproduced 1.0000 meaningful, and a 1,847,428-parameter network is not in that span. Discharging the mechanism needs only the span claim, which the positive control anchors.
scope_limit_from_C2.a_corroboration_I_WITHDRAW: I first offered 'the linear student's agreement RISES with rate while the MLP's FALLS' as evidence for the mechanism. By that review's own C1 logic the falling direction is a FIT signature, not a teacher-structure signature, so it is withdrawn as corroboration. The MLP BEATING the linear student at low perturbation (0.8135 vs 0.7322) stands; the crossover at rate 0.10 (0.7347 vs 0.7506) is a fit artifact and is not evidence for anything here.
